options.name: change_request_mapping
options.description: User mapping for I(Change request) object, where user can override Choice Lists values for objects.

options.name: number
options.description: Number of the record to retrieve. Note that contrary to I(sys_id), I(number) may not uniquely identify a record.

options.name: query
options.description: Provides a set of operators for use with filters, condition builders, and encoded queries. The data type of a field determines what operators are available for it. Refer to the ServiceNow Available Filters Queries documentation at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-platform-user-interface/page/use/common-ui-elements/reference/r_OpAvailableFiltersQueries.html). Mutually exclusive with C(sysparm_query).

options.name: sys_id
options.description: Unique identifier of the record to retrieve.

options.name: sysparm_display_value
options.description: Return field display values C(true), actual values C(false), or both C(all).

options.name: sysparm_query
options.description: An encoded query string used to filter the results as an alternative to C(query). Refer to the ServiceNow Available Filters Queries documentation at U(https://docs.servicenow.com/bundle/tokyo-platform-user-interface/page/use/common-ui-elements/reference/r_OpAvailableFiltersQueries.html). If not set, the value of the C(SN_SYSPARM_QUERY) environment, if specified. Mutually exclusive with C(query).
